title: Shockwave Cyclone Slayer
overview:
Spin through maps with Cyclone and Shockwave. Use a compatible weapon at the Act 3 swap and improve physical DPS as you map.

Build reference by Grim Key. Original guide: https://youtu.be/H9-aXrx93w4
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/3O317e8QoBv2

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Act 1 · Spectral Throw
stages.priority: Improve weapon damage and movement speed.

stages.title: Campaign · Static Strike
stages.goal: Use Static Strike before the Cyclone setup comes online.
stages.priority: Pick up the movement, mark and aura gems.

stages.title: Campaign · Cyclone swap
stages.goal: Use Cyclone and Shockwave with a compatible weapon.
stages.priority: Check mana cost and weapon restrictions before swapping.

stages.title: Early Atlas
stages.goal: Complete your labs and start mapping.
stages.priority: Get a stable link setup, physical DPS and capped resists.

stages.title: Red maps · Physical upgrade
stages.goal: Upgrade the weapon and main links.
stages.priority: Check that your mark, leech and other utility skills trigger.

stages.title: Endgame · Pinnacle progression
stages.goal: Use the level 96 setup as the next investment target.
stages.priority: Prioritize weapon upgrades and keep defensives in place.
